sessionStart.bash: r="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; case "$r" in *'$'*) r= ;; esac; [ -f "$r/bin/petit-poucet" ] || r=$(ls -d "$HOME"/.copilot/installed-plugins/*/petit-poucet 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); if [ -f "$r/bin/petit-poucet" ]; then sh "$r/bin/petit-poucet" hook session-start --agent copilot; else echo "petit-poucet: cannot locate the plugin directory" >&2; echo "{}"; fi

agentStop.bash: r="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; case "$r" in *'$'*) r= ;; esac; [ -f "$r/bin/petit-poucet" ] || r=$(ls -d "$HOME"/.copilot/installed-plugins/*/petit-poucet 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); if [ -f "$r/bin/petit-poucet" ]; then sh "$r/bin/petit-poucet" hook stop --agent copilot; else echo "petit-poucet: cannot locate the plugin directory" >&2; echo "{}"; fi
